subject: planner: add InstacnePlanCache to Domain (#54231)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff against its parent for planner/session/sessionctx changes. This commit wires an instance-level plan cache into the server lifecycle: defines `sessionctx.InstancePlanCache` (`pkg/sessionctx/context.go`), registers the constructor into `domain.NewInstancePlanCache` via `planner/core` package init (`pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_instance.go`), adds `Domain` storage + a 5s eviction ticker goroutine (`pkg/domain/domain.go`), and initializes it during bootstrap with fixed 1,000,000-byte soft/hard limits (`pkg/session/session.go`). No production call-sites use `Domain.GetInstancePlanCache()` yet, so SQL semantics/privilege/txn behavior are unchanged; the eviction loop is a no-op on an empty cache and exits on `Domain.Close()` via `do.exit` + `do.wg.Wait()`.
